wampa::preset.name: Wampa
wampa::preset.notes: Hunts by tracking; buries prey in snow for later.

metadata.name: Jax Vorn
metadata.hair: Dark brown, kept short and unkempt
metadata.features: Faint scar along left jawline, three-day stubble, cocky half-smile
metadata.biography: Jax Vorn is a Corellian smuggler who flies the light freighter "Stardust Drifter". Born in the industrial sectors of Corellia, he learned to fly before he learned to walk — or so he claims. A former low-level associate of Crimson Dawn, Jax ran a "misunderstanding" involving a shipment of spice and a Hutt's favourite pet. Now on the run, he takes whatever honest-ish work keeps fuel in the tanks and credits in his pocket. Beneath the roguish exterior beats a heart of gold — much to his own annoyance.
